top_issues: Header status 'synced' is very small and close to profile icon, offering minimal system status reassurance.
Color legend paragraph directly below the total balance feels text-heavy for a primary dashboard viewport.
Action row buttons (Pay/Receive/Swap) have equal visual weight with high contrast, lacking primary CTA intent.
fixes: Convert the color legend text into an interactive, expandable tooltip or segmented bar breakdown modal.
Highlight 'Pay' or contextual default action with a higher-emphasis accent or filled style.

top_issues: Accounts card shows '+140.00 owes you' but does not immediately clarify liquidity safety versus credit exposure.
Recent activity card shows an isolated 'settled' entry without counterparty avatar or quick receipt drill-down.
Bottom tab navigation icons are slightly thin and low-contrast against pure dark background.
fixes: Include counterparty descriptor badge directly in Recent list items.
Increase active tab icon stroke width and label brightness for bottom bar.

top_issues: Recipient address hex string under H2 is truncated awkwardly without one-tap copy or address book tag.
Capacity label 'Up to 200.00 instantly' conflicts subtly with balance card breakdown below.
Sticky 'Pay 25.00 USDC' CTA rests tightly near screen bottom margin.
fixes: Add explicit address book / ens nickname chip next to truncated hex.
Add safe area bottom padding (min 16px) below the bottom CTA button.

top_issues: Routing list cards (You -> H1 -> H2 vs You -> H1 -> H3 -> H2) feel dense and overly technical for non-power users.
Fee breakdown (0.000050 USDC) shows excessive floating zeros without fiat approximation.
Selection state on route cards uses a subtle border glow that is hard to differentiate in bright environments.
fixes: Display tiny fees as '< $0.01' with hover/tap tooltip for exact 6-decimal precision.
Add a radio/check selection indicator inside route comparison cards.

top_issues: Modal sheet header background blends with dimming overlay, obscuring the drag handle.
Settled duration 'in 9 s' looks like a warning or pending state in green text.
Proof hash truncation '0x835dd4ff...695a' has no explicit copy icon beside it.
fixes: Add an inline copy icon right beside the Proof hash value.
Format settlement latency as standard metadata (e.g. '03:57:12 (9s latency)').

top_issues: Bottom action row splits into three buttons ('Copy receipt', 'Download', 'Done'), creating button crowding on narrow devices.
Background balance numbers are partially exposed above the modal, causing visual collision.
'Verified by your runtime' green indicator lacks a drill-down for cryptographic proof inspection.
fixes: Stack secondary actions or place 'Done' as full-width primary with share/download icons in header.
Ensure backdrop blur or full overlay darkening prevents background text bleed.

top_issues: QR code has an oversized stark white container that is jarring in dark mode.
'3.00 capacity via H1' notice is easy to miss beside the amount field.
'Prepare incoming account' feels like system plumbing rather than an invoice step.
fixes: Soft-tint the QR card background or apply dark-mode friendly QR styling with rounded corners.
Warn prominently if invoice amount exceeds the $3.00 incoming inbound capacity.

top_issues: Your Entity ID shows a massive unformatted 66-character hex string that overwhelms mobile screens.
'Other ways to share' collapsible is subtle and pushed down.
Explaining inbound room mechanics in fine body print is intimidating to casual users.
fixes: Chunk Entity ID into 4-character blocks or provide an alias chip with copy button.
Place primary share options as distinct tap targets (SMS, WhatsApp, Copy).

top_issues: Slider for '100% collateral' vs '0% collateral' at the bottom creates confusion for simple swaps.
Dual token input fields have uneven vertical margins around the swap direction button.
Settlement row 'Bilateral - signed by both sides' needs clear risk explanation.
fixes: Collapse advanced collateral ratio controls behind an 'Advanced Routing & Risk' accordion.
Standardize swap card paddings and invert button positioning.

top_issues: Orderbook depth bars use thin lines that are hard to tap accurately on mobile viewports.
Tap hint '1 tick = 1/10,000 USDC' is dense microstructural jargon.
Sticky 'Swap USDC for WETH' button obscures the bottom rows of the bid side.
fixes: Increase hit targets for orderbook rows to minimum 36px height.
Add explicit bottom padding container so orderbook scroll clears the sticky button.

top_issues: Header action buttons (Pay, Extend credit, Swap, Manage, Dispute) form an asymmetrical 3+2 grid.
Color legend ('secured', 'promised', 'you owe', etc.) uses 5 tiny colored dashes hard to scan.
Credit limit numbers ($143.00 vs $60.00 collateral) lack immediate visualization of liquidation risk.
fixes: Normalize the top action buttons into a uniform 4-column icon grid with 'Dispute' in an overflow/danger slot.
Provide a single stacked segmented bar with clear legends.

top_issues: 'Frames signed: 10' has no inspection link to historical bilateral frames.
'Show 2 empty lanes' text link looks abandoned in negative space.
Dispute button and explanatory footnote are separated by several cards.
fixes: Make 'Frames signed' clickable to view individual frame receipts.
Group empty lanes into a tidy secondary drawer or filter.

top_issues: Pill filters at top (All, Payments, Swaps, Settlement) clip at screen boundary without clear scroll cue.
'Export CSV' is understated as an unstyled text button next to title.
Timestamp hierarchy is inconsistent: some entries show time only, others counterparty.
fixes: Add subtle fade gradient to filter scroll edge.
Standardize activity row subtitle to always show '[Counterparty] • [Timestamp]'.

top_issues: Failed payment receipt shows title 'Sent' with tiny sub-tag 'FAILED', which can mislead users at a quick glance.
'Detail: system/info' exposes raw internal diagnostic strings rather than human-readable failure causes.
Lack of retry or troubleshooting action on failed state.
fixes: Replace title with bold red 'Payment Failed' and an explicit error explanation.
Add 'Retry Payment' and 'View Debug Proof' primary buttons.

top_issues: 'Dollars per pixel' slider is extremely abstract for mainstream wallet users.
Toggle switches have identical visual weight regardless of risk implication.
'Layout on wide screens' toggle appears inside mobile settings where it cannot be experienced.
fixes: Hide wide screen desktop toggles on mobile viewport.
Provide intuitive visual scale presets (e.g. 'Compact', 'Standard', 'Expanded') instead of raw px values.

top_issues: 'Forget vault' destructive button is placed directly below vault recovery controls without warning badge.
Visual scale benchmark diagram ($100 to $100,000) takes substantial vertical space for a niche setting.
Runtime ID hex is not truncated and crowds row margins.
fixes: Move 'Forget vault' to an explicit danger zone at the bottom of settings.
Collapse scale visualization into an interactive preview previewer.

top_issues: Three-way location matrix (Wallet, Reserve, Account) repeated across FROM and TO is visual overkill.
Horizontal scrolling cards inside FROM/TO containers risk accidental swipe conflicts on mobile.
'Add to batch' action sits awkwardly isolated above the primary sign button.
fixes: Use segmented pill selectors or dropdown source/destination switches instead of duplicated 3-card sets.
Integrate batching into an action bar toggle or count indicator.

top_issues: The top FROM row is partially cut off above the viewport when scrolling down.
'Recipient entity • leave empty for yourself' is confusing placeholder guidance.
Explanatory block 'What happens' uses a low-contrast radio icon bullet.
fixes: Change entity input to 'Destination Address / Entity (optional)' with self-toggle switch.
Sticky summarize selected movement: 'Reserve → H1 Account' above the Sign button.

top_issues: Manage hub navigation uses a 2-column card grid with uneven badge heights.
'Where your money stands' summary repeats the balance screen with slight wording changes.
Bottom 'Accounts' card is clipped by screen boundary.
fixes: Harmonize card heights in the top navigation grid.
Unify nomenclature across Home ('Promised') and Manage ('Promised by hubs').

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' is repeated under every token without clear explanation of approval limits.
Signer and Depository addresses are truncated to unreadable 10-char blobs.
'Move into reserve' button floats inside the card list like a table item.
fixes: Replace allowance text with an allowance manager link or toggle.
Promote 'Move into reserve' to a clean header or bottom utility bar.

top_issues: Stacked action buttons ('Receive USDC', 'USDC to on-chain wallet', 'Gas', etc.) look identical and unranked.
'Extend credit limit' slider defaults to 0% collateral with scary permanent limit implications.
Notice 'Add 10% buffer to new credit only' is micro-accounting that confuses basic asset management.
fixes: Differentiate primary on/off-ramp actions from protocol credit adjustments.
Group on-chain withdrawals into a dedicated transfer sub-menu.

top_issues: Hub selection 'H1 (3 lanes)' assumes deep familiarity with internal protocol topology.
Token selection cards take up disproportionate vertical real estate.
Lend/Borrow pill switch is nestled below token selection instead of at the top of page.
fixes: Move Lend/Borrow mode selector to the very top header level.
Use a compact token selector dropdown instead of large cards.

top_issues: Term selector chips ('1 hour', '1 day', '1 month') lack APR comparison context.
Interest rate input asks for 'basis points' directly, which is unintuitive for retail lenders.
Pool health metrics ('Available 0.00', 'Borrowed 0.00') show flat zero without pool utilization %.
fixes: Allow inputting plain percentage (e.g. '8.5% APY') with automated basis point conversion.
Add a visual utilization gauge to the H1 Pool card.

top_issues: 'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is hard protocol jargon for governance.
Threshold '1 of 1' has no action button to initiate key addition or multi-sig setup.
'Register it on the EntityProvider to issue shares' provides no link or button to do so.
fixes: Add an 'Add Signer / Rotate Keys' CTA button inside the Board card.
Provide a direct link or modal trigger for EntityProvider registration.

top_issues: Title hero '$40.00' represents 'Enforceable right now' rather than total net worth, creating cognitive dissonance with Home.
Explanatory paragraph on Green vs Violet is identical word-for-word to Home screen text.
'Save evidence bundle' button is pushed near bottom fold.
fixes: Add a small comparison anchor: 'Enforceable: $40.00 of $180.00 Total'.
Give 'Save evidence bundle' a distinct secondary badge or icon button.

top_issues: Counterparty summary 'they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d' is terse to the point of ambiguity.
Dispute challenge button is absent on this view despite stating 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1'.
Ledger status 'signed 1 min ago' has no manual verify or sync refresh icon.
fixes: Clarify dispute timeout: 'Dispute window: 24h counterparty challenge / 24h user claim'.
Add direct 'Trigger Dispute' anchor directly inside the counterparty card.

overall.verdict: The interface delivers exceptional mathematical honesty and protocol determinism, anchored by its strict proportional visual scaling and bilateral state guarantees. However, its mobile UX frequently overwhelms casual and semi-technical users by exposing raw hub mechanics, basis point math, and cryptic failure codes.
priority_fixes: Simplify Inbound/Receive UX: Auto-provision incoming capacity or display plain language warnings when an invoice exceeds hub capacity, removing raw Entity ID barriers.
Humanize Transaction Errors & Proofs: Replace raw strings like 'system/info' on failed receipts with plain-English diagnostics, resolution paths, and quick retry actions.
Progressive Disclosure for DeFi & Collateral: Hide collateral sliders, tick math, and basis point interest rates behind an 'Advanced' switch so casual swaps remain as straightforward as Uniswap.

Elevate Dispute & Enforceability Actions: Provide a 1-tap Dispute flow directly on the Sovereignty and Counterparty screens, pairing the evidence bundle download with a direct testnet/mainnet challenge trigger.
Standardize Action Button Hierarchy: Clean up cluttered button groups (such as the 3+2 Account grid and Move's triple card layouts) to guarantee clean, one-handed mobile ergonomics.
